application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Grounds of 4 Northumberland Place Car  Park

T1 A,B,C : Leylandii trees groupe  x3 [outside No. 7] – Fell to ground level 

Height of tree currently:  7M
Height of tree after reduction:  0M

Spread of tree currently: 7M
Spread of tree after reduction: OM


T2: Leylandii tree [outside No. 11] – Fell to ground level 

Height of tree currently:  7M
Height of tree after reduction:  0M

Spread of tree currently: 5M
Spread of tree after reduction: OM

Reason for Works:
We are looking to remove the x4 Leylandii trees due to their location directly over the allocated visitor and resident parking bays. Bird droppings from the trees are causing issues for vehicles parked beneath them, making the bays difficult to use. Their location also restricts access for larger vans when tradespeople are carrying out work on the grounds.
